class.name: GameplayReplicationGraph
class.brief_description: Server relevancy, spatial candidate, dormancy, and per-connection scheduling policy.
class.description: Maintains authoritative connection views and object descriptors independently of ENet or another transport. Distance objects are indexed by a uniform three-dimensional grid; other policies use a nonspatial candidate set. [method plan_connection] applies exact policy, emits stable enter/leave sets, enforces update frequency and an estimated-byte budget, then orders due objects by base priority plus starvation credit and object ID. Selected IDs are handed to [GameplayMultiplayerReplication], which retains responsibility for property conditions, fragmentation, sender validation, and transport writes.

method.name: add_connection
method.description: Copies a new authoritative connection view into the graph.

method.name: add_object
method.description: Copies and indexes a new object descriptor.

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes all connection, object, grid, schedule, and statistics state.

method.name: get_connection_peer_ids
method.description: Returns registered peer IDs in ascending order.

method.name: get_last_plan_stats
method.description: Returns the latest plan counts and byte statistics. [code]estimated_bytes[/code] is the current pass budget charge, [code]actual_bytes[/code] is the current pass's successful encoded transport bytes, and the [code]total_*[/code] fields accumulate only real sends and their configured estimates.

method.name: get_relevant_object_ids
method.description: Returns the connection's last exact relevant set in ascending order. Dormant objects remain relevant but are not scheduled.

method.name: has_connection
method.description: Returns whether a connection view exists.

method.name: has_object
method.description: Returns whether an object descriptor exists.

method.name: is_object_dormant
method.description: Returns whether scheduling is suspended for the object.

method.name: notify_object_dirty
method.description: Wakes a dormant object only when the authoritative state serial is newer than the serial captured on entering dormancy.

method.name: plan_connection
method.description: Refreshes exact relevance and returns [code]entered[/code], [code]left[/code], [code]selected[/code], candidate/relevant/due/selected counts, the configured budget, and byte statistics. The caller must report each selected outcome with [method record_send_result].

method.name: record_send_result
method.description: Commits successful pacing and measured encoded bytes, or adds starvation credit after failure. Transport adapters, rather than clients, call this method.

method.name: remove_connection
method.description: Removes a connection view and its scheduling history.

method.name: remove_object
method.description: Removes an object from its index and all connection histories.

method.name: set_object_dormant
method.description: Starts or stops dormancy. When starting, captures the authoritative state serial used by dirty wake-up.

method.name: set_object_owner_peer_id
method.description: Updates server-recorded gameplay ownership without changing network authority.

method.name: update_connection
method.description: Replaces the copied position, team, and budget for an existing connection.

method.name: update_object
method.description: Replaces and reindexes an existing descriptor while preserving dormancy.

method.name: wake_object
method.description: Explicitly resumes scheduling for a dormant object.

members.member: Uniform spatial grid cell edge length. Changing it rebuilds the object index.
Maximum accepted distance-policy radius and connection query extent. This bounds ordinary-world candidate lookup; it is not a world streaming system.
